# XCBR (IEC 61850-7-4:2007B6), profile default

coverage: 3 measured or mapped, 2 mapped, 1 excluded, 0 unmapped, 37 not measured

## Measurements

XCBR.OpCnt | operation-count | switching.opcnt
XCBR.Pos | switch-position | switching.pos

## Data objects

Pos DPC (SwitchingEquipmentLN): mapped switching.pos
SumSwARs BCR (XCBR): excluded — accumulated switched current, whose unit (A or A²t) is device configuration
